        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.normalizedSubmodulePolytope_eq_hull (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {I : Type v} (Q : I → FiniteProjective R) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
        normalizedSubmodulePolytope k Q M = (convexHull ℝ) {v : I → ℝ | ∃ (U : FGModuleCat R) (j : U ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.Mono j ∧ ∀ (i : I), v i = ↑(homFinrank k (↑(Q i)) U) / ↑(homFinrank k M M)}

        In these coordinates the generators are precisely the normalized Hom dimension vectors of subobjects.

        The normalized polytope is generated by a subset of the integer grid.
